cross_cutting_findings: One top-level public unit must equal one genuine event/evolving narrative chain; rhetorical similarity alone forms a narrative family, not an event chain.
Supported event facts inside deceptive chains must remain supported and must not inherit false/Lie labels.
Publication acts and asserted factual content are different propositions.
Exact counts require matching denominators; repetitions and evidentiary inferences must not inflate unique-proposition metrics.
Controls, rhetoric, declaratory policy, and supported context must not inflate accusation/Lie denominators.
The final sweep consumes the Sep. 19 canonical source-completion packet while preserving the sealed Sep. 9 adjudication artifact as historical input.
Source qualification clears provenance blockers only; it does not automatically satisfy the claimant-knowledge prong.
Later evidence may adjudicate earlier factual truth without being backdated into statement-time public or claimant knowledge.
remaining_integration_work: Run exact-head cross-surface regression after the completed semantic overlay.
Preserve any knowledge finding that remains evidence-incomplete as public-safe no-Lie/withheld output rather than manufacturing source or claimant access.

routing: Falsifiable event/attribution/BDA claims appended to current claim-domain state.
Repetitions share proposition identity and do not inflate unique-proposition counts.
Negotiation, legal-authority, private-diplomacy, rhetoric and declaratory-policy items are preserved as controls and excluded from ordinary accusation counts.
Sep. 18 re-adjudications update existing propositions rather than creating duplicate rows.

false_media_intake.rule: FALSE media artifact findings remain separate from real physical-event findings and from official-origin/knowledge findings. No official attribution is manufactured where provenance is absent.
